caption:
Stock market news | Tata Sons no HC relief ahead of board meeting Monday

Bombay High Court refused to grant interim relief to the two Tata trusts, allowing Tata Sons board meeting to proceed as scheduled on Monday. The board will discuss finalising Tata Sons' IPO plans, but any decision will still depend on the court's final judgment.
